title: Keyboard Manager - Duplicates and Settings
author: r-katabasis
summary: Editing a Keyboard Manager remap can duplicate it, Allow chords can re-enable itself, and affected remaps can disable ordinary Ctrl or End behavior.
next_action: Route the two known symptoms to their existing trackers and request a separate focused report only if edit-time duplication still reproduces.

confidence.rationale: The live report and comment explicitly map two symptoms to existing open trackers.

judgment.rationale: Two independently actionable symptoms are already tracked in #49085 and #47806; the remaining edit-duplication symptom needs a standalone minimal reproduction rather than a combined fix.
evidence: The report says Allow chords becomes checked again after being disabled, matching #49085.
The report says remappings become disabled or interfere with normal keys, matching the persisted-enable-state failures in #47806.
The report also mentions duplication after editing, but gives no isolated edit sequence for that third symptom.
judgment.recommended_action: Route the two known symptoms to their existing trackers and request a separate focused report only if edit-time duplication still reproduces.

fix_assessment.rationale: The known symptoms already have dedicated trackers, and the remaining duplication symptom is not isolated enough for a distinct fix plan.

issue_context.summary: Editing a Keyboard Manager remap can duplicate it, Allow chords can re-enable itself, and affected remaps can disable ordinary Ctrl or End behavior.
known_information: The report is against PowerToys 0.100 and includes a diagnostic ZIP.
The example is an app-specific Ctrl+End to End remap.
A later comment already links the Allow chords symptom to #49085.
inferences: The combined report likely contains more than one Keyboard Manager editor/state bug.
issue_context.analysis: Splitting the symptoms prevents one fix from being treated as covering unrelated persistence, duplication, and runtime key-state behavior.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live report and comment.
Compared the symptoms with live issues #49085 and #47806.

actions.label: Split into existing Keyboard Manager trackers

comment.body: This report combines multiple behaviors. The `Allow chords` setting re-enabling itself is tracked in #49085, and shortcut enable/disable persistence is tracked in #47806. Please keep those investigations in their dedicated issues. If editing still creates a duplicate entry on the current release, open a focused report with the exact original row, edit performed, saved rows, and whether the duplicate survives reopening the editor.
